_readme: US-1995 AC4: the SHARED behavioural fixture for backwards title sync.
There are two implementations of this logic — services/edge-functions/src/lib/title-sync.ts
and src/lib/title-sync.ts — because the edge and the web app are separate projects that
cannot import each other. They are declared to stay in lockstep and NOTHING pinned them:
the two files differ by ~80 lines, much of it legitimate (the web copy inlines the trim
because it cannot import title-trim.ts), which is exactly why a source diff cannot be the
So the guard is BEHAVIOURAL. Both suites load this file and assert the same inputs produce
the same outputs. Add a case here, not to one suite.

syncTitle.name: brand swap, exact token
syncTitle.title: Patagonia Better Sweater Fleece Jacket Men's Medium
syncTitle.expected: Arc'teryx Better Sweater Fleece Jacket Men's Medium

syncTitle.name: case is transferred from the original token
syncTitle.title: PATAGONIA Better Sweater Fleece Jacket

syncTitle.name: multi-word brand
syncTitle.title: The North Face Nuptse Puffer Jacket Medium

syncTitle.name: no-op when the old value is absent
syncTitle.title: Patagonia Better Sweater Fleece Jacket

syncTitle.name: several fields in one pass
syncTitle.title: Patagonia Fleece Jacket Size L Navy
syncTitle.expected: Arc'teryx Fleece Jacket Size XL Black

syncTitle.name: token boundary — a substring inside a word is NOT replaced
syncTitle.title: Patagonian Wool Blend Coat

syncTitle.name: blank from/to is ignored rather than blanking the title
syncTitle.title: Patagonia Fleece Jacket

syncTitle.name: an empty change list leaves the title untouched
syncTitle.title: Patagonia Fleece Jacket

changesFromItemDiff.name: only changed syncable fields are reported
no changes yields an empty list
